name: design-system
description: Build and maintain a production React design system. Interviews you for your primitive layer, component layer, CSS system, colour, typography and motion library, then scaffolds DTCG tokens (light/dark, density, multi-brand), components on a wave-based roadmap (including an icon system and layout primitives), an inventory site with authored pattern/content guidance, behavioural + a11y + visual-regression tests, token lint rules, codemods, governance scaffolds and npm packaging — from a single machine-readable registry served to AI agents as AGENTS.md, llms.txt and an MCP server.
